name: lodash-capitalize-sails-navigator
behavioral_change: lodash 4.0.0 changed `_.capitalize` to uppercase the first character and lowercase the rest, whereas v_old changed only the first character. The function name and call form are unchanged.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (sails-navigator) derives controller names with `_.capitalize(_.camelCase(routeFragments.pop()))` in `index.coffee`; after the upgrade `KebabCaseController` becomes `KebabcaseController`, which does not exist. The single failure is `AssertionError: expected 'KebabcaseController' to equal 'KebabCaseController'` with frames only in `test/index.spec.coffee`; lodash, `capitalize` and `index.coffee` never appear.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes the two `_.capitalize` calls in `index.coffee` (lines 171 and 174) to `_.upperFirst`.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), section Compatibility Warnings, declares the `_.capitalize` change and links to `_.upperFirst` (https://lodash.com/docs#upperFirst). Tier 2: the replacement is named in prose but no code is shown.
failing_tests: test/index.spec.coffee :: navigator ... When passing a route in kebab-case (words separated by hyphens) should guess the controller equivalent in camelCase
